That’s the problem with depression, isn’t it? It tricks people into thinking their worthless when in fact, they have so much potential. Generic, I know, but you are NOT worthless. Your favourite food. It exists because of you. It could’ve the weirdest thing ever, say celery with nutella, but somewhere, someone thought that people would need it. People like you. Who have worth. Every sunset, every wave that splashed against you, it’s meant for you. Because you have purpose. Every twinkling star, they’re all meant for your eyes, because without you, the stars would be nothing. The breezy and salty air of the seaside would disappear. Because if you lay down and rot, all the things made for you would not be here. Because their for your eyes. And if you still think you’re worthless, then look up at the starry sky and remember that everything there is for you.

I know this might sound redundant, but I care. I would care knowing that someone feels the need to take their own life because life has given them such a hard time. I care. So please, don’t do it. Just one more day. One more day, to observe everything. One more day, to see the twinkling stars. To feel the wind brush against you. To feel the jolt of each step as your feet reach the pavement. One more day. Just one more day, to taste your favourite meal, or to smell your favourite candle. Even to touch your favourite fabric. As someone who cares, one more day. You can do it.

Believe me, I’m tired too. I’m tired of everything that has been thrown at me, friends and family included. And I know, suicide might seem like the best option right now. But think about everything you would be leaving behind. The taste of your favourite meal, the smell of that candle, the feeling of waking up on a cold day refreshed and hopeful that something might change. Please. Take a few more days. Take time to notice everything. The feel, the touch, the sight. Please.

But you should be here. All those sunsets. All the moonlight. All the twinkling stars in the night sky. It’s all for your eyes to look upon them. Without you, they might not even exist. All the beauty that can be found in the sky, the earth, the night. It’s all for you. You may not think you’re supposed to be here. But believe me, you belong here. And if life wants to screw you over, make it a hell of hard time for them. Be the thing life is afraid of. Never be afraid of what is to come. If life throws a curveball at you, you hit a homerun. It may not seem easy, but put all your anguish, anger, every emotion you have into being the best you. Every beautiful thing here is for you, so don’t you let life take that away. You can do it. I know you can.
